text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
With summer camp reaching its final stage—
I found myself working late into the night
when it happened.
Wahyaaaaaaaaa~!?！？！？

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: A tremendous noise echoed from the kitchen! Rushing over to check on the situation...

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
...There, I picked up the bowl for you.
Can you stand? Don't rush, take it easy.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Hauu, I'm sorry, I'm so sorry...!
Thank you so much, hauu...!!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Hawa!?
E-Even Ayabe-san's Trainer-san is here...!
Uuu, I'm so sorry for making such a fuss~!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Doto-chan, are you okay?

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Ehehe, with everyone together, it's gotten so lively!
choice_data_list: Um, what on earth is going on...?

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
A-And so... Urara-san was hungry,
so we were thinking of making a midnight
snack together, buuut...

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: And then, guess what? The bowl went whoosh! And then, the pot went ka-blam!! It was so much fun~!!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Auuuugh!
I'm so sorry for being so clumsy and useless, I'm so sorry!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: A-And then, when things turned into complete chaos, Ayabe-san came to my rescue~...!

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: You're wrong... I just came to make a late-night snack too.
choice_data_list: (Still, she rushed over here even faster than me.)
(Still, she rushed over here even faster than me.)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Pointing out that I was in the very next room would be tactless, so I kept quiet.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: ...For now, I'd like to fulfill our purpose here, but...

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: ...Are sandwiches fine for you guys too?

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Huh! Ayabe-san, you're gonna make it for me!?

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
I told you, I came down here to make a late-night snack for myself too.
...It's just an afterthought.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: If you're not satisfied with the menu, there isn't much I can do for you.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
I'm not really good at cooking in general.
When it comes to sweets, I don't even know how to make them.
...All I can make are sandwiches.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
D-D-Dissatisfied?! Not at all!!
B-But, um, are you really sure about this...?!

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: The amount of effort doesn't really change much.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: ...So you don't have any complaints? Then hold on a bit while I get ready.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Hawa! Um, um, I-I'll
help out too~...!
I-I'll make sure not to get in the way!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And with that, Admire Vega skillfully
and deftly assembled the sandwich
with practiced ease...!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Uwaaah! Whenever I try to add cucumbers or tomatoes,
the moisture soaks into the bread
and makes it all soggy...!

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
"...Lightly sprinkle salt and let it sit for a bit.
Then wipe away the drawn-out moisture with a paper towel."

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
"Oh, I've already separated the salt into portions for sprinkling.
...Use that."

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Ayabe-san...! Thank you so much!
With this, even someone clumsy like me won't mess up~!!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Hey, hey, hey, Ayabe-san!!
There were bananas over that way--!!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
I wonder if it'll taste good if we sandwich them together!?
Can I try?

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: ...Do you want to try using fruit?

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
In that case, would an orange be okay instead of a banana?
I think that'd pair better with the ham and lettuce I'm making right now.

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Orange! Wow, orange sounds great too!!
Then, then, I'll peel it!

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
Once you peel them, put them on the cutting board.
I'll slice them into rounds.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And so, in the blink of an eye—

text_block_list.name: Dotou & Urara
text_block_list.text: So delicious~!!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Ayabe-san's sandwich gives me sooo much energy~!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
The orange one is sweet and salty,
and so yummy!! Amazing, amazing!!

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Exaggerating...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Admire Vega mutters as if troubled,
but even just watching from the sidelines, one can tell
it is an exquisite masterpiece.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Even while dealing with those two who were completely unpredictable, her hands moved seamlessly, looking thoroughly accustomed to making it—

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: ...I just had a lot of chances to make it.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
Because it's easy to carry around.
...Like when I'm stargazing.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: So... it's not like I particularly like it or anything.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: ......Probably.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And so, I was warmly watching over the Umamusume as they relished their sandwiches, but—

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: ...Hey.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
If you leave it out for too long, it'll fall apart.
...If you're not going to eat it, I'll wrap it up, okay?
choice_data_list: ...Wait, was there even a share for me in the first place!?
...Wait, was there even a share for me in the first place!?

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
...Though it would be strange of me
not to make any for you, wouldn't it?

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: There were four people in the kitchen, after all.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Is that really... how it is?
I'm thoroughly impressed by just how
unusually dutiful she is being.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: "Anyway, you're not going to eat it now? If so, I'll wrap it up and put it in the fridge."
choice_data_list: N-No, I'm eating it right now!
N-no, I'll eat it right now!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And so, the one chosen was—
choice_data_list: This'll give you energy! A "BLT Sandwich"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: I decided to go with the BLT sandwich, which she had mostly prepared alongside Meisho Doto.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: "Taking a big bite—the crispy, savory aroma of carefully cooked bacon and the fresh, juicy crunch of tomatoes and cucumbers fill my mouth completely!"

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Wah...!
Ehehe, I'm so glad Ayabe-san's Trainer liked it too~.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Thanks to Ayabe-san, it feels like I've found something tonight that I can hold my head high about...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Thank you so, so much...

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: ...Like I said, you're overreacting.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: I decided to go with the orange sandwich, which she had mostly prepared alongside Haru Urara.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The saltiness of the thick-cut ham and the sweet tanginess of the orange
go together better than expected, and the lettuce wrapping it all up
creates a beautiful balance!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Yay!! Guess what, guess what?
It's got a super duper kind and gentle flavor!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
When I said I wanted to do it,
Ayabe-san didn't say no!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
"That's why it's a kind-tasting sandwich,
made by the kind Ayabe-san!"

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: What's that supposed to mean...
